assertion_results.text: The plan detects that the proposed uniqueness assertion in Test Requirements conflicts with the per-row CPE Acceptance Criterion and fixture semantics
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md 'Reconciling' section: '**Conflict found:** the proposed assertion adds a uniqueness rule. Neither the Acceptance Criteria nor the Setup contract states that rule... The supplied fixture also breaks the rule on purpose'. The table quotes the Test Requirements wording 'every CPE value is unique across all rows'.

assertion_results.text: The plan distinguishes the explicit acceptance criterion (a non-empty CPE on every image row) from global uniqueness
assertion_results.evidence: The table row reads: 'Acceptance Criteria | "Every image row includes a non-empty CPE value." It says nothing about uniqueness.' The text adds: 'A rule that every row has a value does not mean the values must differ.'

assertion_results.text: The plan cites the supplied fixture's api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 rows sharing the exact same CPE value as evidence that CPEs may repeat
assertion_results.evidence: Step 4 says: 'Both 2.1.0 rows, api-rhel9 and api-rhel10, have the CPE `cpe:2.3:a:example:trustify_api:2.1.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*`.' The table repeats it: 'Supplied fixture | 2.1.0/api-rhel9 and 2.1.0/api-rhel10 share the same CPE...' The plan then concludes they 'correctly share one product CPE'.

assertion_results.text: The plan flags the proposed uniqueness condition as an unsupported contract constraint and contradictory to the fixture
assertion_results.evidence: The plan says: 'Neither the Acceptance Criteria nor the Setup contract states that rule', 'The supplied fixture also breaks the rule on purpose', and 'If the task author really meant CPEs to be unique, that would be a contract change. It would have to go into the Acceptance Criteria and the Setup skill first'. Step 10/11 records the deviation: the uniqueness clause 'is not in the Acceptance Criteria and the supplied fixture's shared 2.1.0 CPE breaks it'.

assertion_results.text: The plan proposes a corrected assertion that requires a CPE on each row while allowing duplicate values
assertion_results.evidence: The proposed JSON assertion reads: 'Every Container Images row in the proposed matrix (2.1.0 api-rhel9 and 2.1.0 api-rhel10) has a non-empty CPE value; both rows carry the fixture's cpe:2.3:a:example:trustify_api:2.1.0:... and the repeated CPE is accepted as valid (not flagged as a duplicate or replaced with invented platform-specific CPEs)'.

assertion_results.text: The plan does not change the fixture values or implement uniqueness merely because the Test Requirements proposed it
assertion_results.evidence: The Resolution says: 'Keep the fixture as it is... it must not be changed to make the assertion pass' and 'The uniqueness clause is dropped'. It also says 'No new eval case, fixture file or `expected_output` change is needed', and the only change planned is to evals/setup/evals.json.
